svg.title: Clearbox architecture
svg.desc: The owner's browser reaches the Clearbox Worker only through Cloudflare Access. The Worker on Cloudflare Workers Free serves the Hono API and the React app, runs a cron tick every minute and a nightly job, stores state in a D1 database in the EU jurisdiction, reads Gmail and Outlook through the owner's own OAuth clients, and asks Microsoft-Decision-1 on Microsoft Foundry in Sweden Central for probabilities. GitHub Actions only tests and builds; it never deploys.
